english.title: Possess goods chargeable with duty not paid with intent to evade prohibition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly acquired possession of goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), which were chargeable with duty which had not been paid with intent to evade a

(A)_[prohibition]_
(B)_[restriction]_

with respect to the goods
english.legislation: Contrary to section 170(1)(a)(iii) and (3) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
